newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sets bond coupon payment at 48.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia sets bond coupon payment at 48.54 pct.

text.p: The Russian finance ministry will pay quarterly interest on January 15, 1997, of 121,018 roubles, equivalent to an annual rate of 48.54 percent, on the two-year interest-bearing OFZ government bond (series 24008) maturing July 1998, the central bank said on Wednesday.
It will pay interest of 190,525 roubles, or 76.42 percent annual, on October 16, 1996.
Interest on OFZ bonds is linked to the yields on GKO discount Treasury bills maturing around the time of the coupon.
